Open viewing: Saturday 03/10/2026 from 12:00pm - 1:00pm

No. 23 Woodlands Grove is an Exceptional Two-Bedroom Penthouse Apartment.

The Penthouses at Woodlands Grove comprise a rare collection of just three exceptional residences, occupying the entire top floor of this boutique Blackrock development. Apartments No. 23, 24 and 25 occupy the entire penthouse level, offering a level of privacy, aspect and natural light rarely found in apartment living. Each residence enjoys a dual-aspect orientation, with views towards the Dublin Mountains to the front and elevated outlooks across the surrounding landscape to the rear.

Fully furnished, incorporating bespoke joinery and a custom media wall that enhances the living environment. Generous terraces ranging from approximately 24 sq.m to 41 sq.m extend directly from the living spaces, creating seamless indoor–outdoor living ideal for entertaining or quiet retreat.

Internally, expansive open-plan living, dining and kitchen areas are filled with natural light and centred around bespoke contemporary kitchens featuring Quartz Calacatta Gold worktops, full-height cabinetry and integrated Miele appliances, including wine fridges. Carefully selected materials, feature lighting and elevated ceiling heights create interiors that feel both refined and welcoming. Bedrooms are calm and generously proportioned, with fitted or walk-in wardrobes providing excellent storage.

Bathrooms and en suites are finished to a hotel-inspired standard, incorporating contemporary tiling, premium sanitaryware, rain-head showers and heated towel rails. Designed with long-term comfort and efficiency in mind, each penthouse achieves a minimum A3 BER and incorporates air-to-water heat pump systems, heat recovery ventilation and high-performance glazing.

Located just minutes from Blackrock Village, Woodlands Grove provides immediate access to coastal amenities, dining, shopping and excellent transport connections. A rare opportunity to acquire a top-floor residence within a low-density, design-led development in one of Dublin’s premier residential locations. For further information please call Andrew Mawhinney or John Kirby on 01-845 5509
